panels.title: Google SRE SLO & Error Budget Runbook Reference
panels.description: SRE formulas and mathematical reference for incident triage

options.content:
### 📐 SRE Mathematical Reference

- **Service Level Indicator (SLI):**
  $$\text{SLI} = \frac{\text{Successful Requests}}{\text{Total Requests}} \times 100$$

- **Error Budget:**
  $$\text{Total Allowed Error Rate} = 1 - \text{SLO Target} \quad (\text{e.g., } 1 - 0.995 = 0.5\%$$

- **Error Budget Remaining (%):**
  $$\text{Budget Left} = \left(1 - \frac{\text{Actual Error Rate}}{\text{Allowed Error Rate}}\right) \times 100$$

- **Burn Rate Rules (Mimir Ruler Alerts):**
  - **14.4x Burn (1h window):** Burns 2% of 30-day budget in 1 hour $\rightarrow$ **PAGES ON-CALL** (AWS Incident Manager)
  - **6.0x Burn (6h window):** Burns 5% of 30-day budget in 6 hours $\rightarrow$ **PAGES ON-CALL**
  - **3.0x Burn (24h window):** Burns 10% of budget in 24 hours $\rightarrow$ **File Jira/Slack Ticket**
  - **1.0x Burn (3d window):** Sustainable burn (consumes exactly 100% over 30 days)
